title: Formatting toolbar with tooltips and toggle buttons
prompt: Build a text-formatting toolbar with three toggle buttons named "Bold", "Italic" and "Underline", grouped as a toolbar (role="toolbar") labelled "Formatting". Each button shows a tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus with its name and shortcut: "Bold (Ctrl+B)", "Italic (Ctrl+I)" and "Underline (Ctrl+U)". Each button toggles its pressed state, which it reports with aria-pressed. Below the toolbar, show "Active: none" or the active formats in toolbar order, for example "Active: Bold, Underline".
